title: Tech Lead Java
description:
Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.


Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.


Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:

Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Engajamento: Na Bluesoft, atuamos com energia, buscamos a excelência e assumimos a responsabilidade coletiva para crescer juntos e alcançar grandes resultados.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Sobre a vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Tech Lead Java com experiência comprovada em liderança de times técnicos. Procuramos alguém com sólida bagagem em desenvolvimento backend, que conheça os desafios de ambientes de alta performance e que tenha atuado como referência técnica e gestora de equipe.

O(a) profissional ideal sabe equilibrar o desenvolvimento de código com a gestão do time, promovendo boas práticas, apoiando o time e garantindo a qualidade técnica das entregas.


Responsabilidades:


  • Atuar como referência técnica para o time de desenvolvimento.
  • Garantir a qualidade, escalabilidade e performance das soluções.
  • Apoiar o time na tomada de decisões técnicas e resolução de problemas.
  • Realizar code reviews e propor melhorias técnicas contínuas.
  • Participar ativamente do desenvolvimento de soluções (mão na massa).
  • Conduzir ritos ágeis e colaborar com áreas parceiras.
  • Gerenciar e acompanhar o desempenho do time (1:1, feedbacks, planos de desenvolvimento).
  • Estimular boas práticas de engenharia de software.
  • Acompanhar prazos de entrega de melhorias e correções de bugs, garantindo previsibilidade e alinhamento.
  • Acompanhar tendências e propor soluções com uso de Inteligência Artificial, especialmente voltadas à automação, ganho de produtividade e melhoria de processos.


Requisitos obrigatórios:


  • Experiência comprovada como Tech Lead Java.
  • Sólida experiência com Java 8 ou superior (utilizamos Java 21), além de Spring Boot e Spring MVC.
  • Experiência com Hibernate, JUnit 5, Mockito 2 e Git.
  • Vivência com bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL).
  • Experiência com Redis.
  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de APIs.
  • Familiaridade com VueJS, TypeScript e Javascript.
  • Experiência em ambientes de alta concorrência, performance e grandes volumes de dados.
  • Habilidade de liderança e gestão de pessoas.



Desejáveis:


  • Experiência com análise de logs e troubleshooting.
  • Otimização de queries e análise de performance.
  • Conhecimento em Kibana/APM.
  • Conhecimento em MongoDB e PL/SQL.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento mobile (Ionic + VueJS).
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias legadas: JSP, AngularJS, jQuery.


Ambiente técnico:


  • Metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Infraestrutura em AWS.
  • Integração contínua com Jenkins, Sonar e Docker.
  • Repositórios no GitHub.
  • IntelliJ Ultimate como IDE.

title: Platform Engineer / DevOps Engineer SR
description:
Descrição da Vaga

Buscamos um(a) Platform Engineer / DevOps Engineer SR para atuar na construção e evolução de serviços de infraestrutura de plataforma, adotando práticas modernas de automação, observabilidade e infraestrutura como produto, suportando times de desenvolvimento com ambientes escaláveis, seguros e resilientes.

Responsabilidades

  • Vivência em ambientes complexos e distribuídos.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
TGG Way Accounting Manager

Location: Fully Remote working for US-Based Clients


About Us

We are a dynamic and growing accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.


The Accounting Manager (AM) is an expert responsible for overseeing financial accounting and transaction processing. They serve as ambassadors of TGG Way™ and US GAAP accounting standards . Accounting Managers provide 100% accurate and complete financial statements to Controllers. They play a key role in training and mentoring staff (both internal and external) on internal controls, systems, and processes following the TGG Way™ .

Additionally, Accounting Managers act as a bridge between TGG and the client , ensuring continuous communication, implementing processes, addressing client needs, and relaying key information to other team members.


Key Responsibilities


Month-End Close & Core Accounting

  • Prepare and review journal entries and account reconciliations
  • Support the month-end close process following established checklists
  • Review P&L and balance sheet for accuracy before submission to the Controller
  • Maintain organized supporting documentation and workpapers

Financial Reporting

  • Prepare monthly financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow)
  • Perform basic variance analysis and flag inconsistencies
  • Ensure consistency and accuracy across financial reports and schedules

Accounting Operations

  • Review AP, AR, and credit card reconciliations
  • Support payroll processing and review prior to submission
  • Maintain and review the chart of accounts
  • Assist with recurring weekly and monthly accounting processes

Team Support & Review

  • Review work prepared by junior accountants or bookkeepers
  • Provide guidance, feedback, and basic training as needed
  • Ensure data accuracy and adherence to internal processes

Client & Internal Collaboration

  • Communicate with internal team members regarding open items and deadlines
  • Support client requests and questions under Controller supervision
  • Identify process improvement opportunities and escalate recommendations


Requirements

  • 4+ years of accounting experience
  • Experience working with U.S.-based clients and exposure to U.S. GAAP
  • Strong understanding of month-end close, journal entries, and reconciliations
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks Online or NetSuite (preferred)
  • Strong Excel skills (formulas, data organization, basic analysis)
  • Fluent English (written and spoken)
  • Accounting or Finance degree
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.
  • Can work US Timezone schedules (such as PST, EST)


Compensation & Benefits

  • USD 2,500–3,500 per month , based on experience
  • Fully remote role with some flexibility included
  • Paid training in U.S. GAAP and internal processes
  • Access to TGG University and learning resources
  • Career development / Long-term growth opportunities within a global firm
  • Unlimited PTO after onboarding period (holidays included)


Notes:

This position is to join us as Independent Contractor

Payment after 90 days will be based on hours worked (can be 8 or 4 hours per day)

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave



About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.


We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world, in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.


Our Core Values:

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability

title: Wordpress Developer
description:
About Flatiron Software Co.

Flatiron is a fully remote, US-based software company delivering high-impact, modern digital experiences. We work with mission-driven organizations, media groups, and product teams to build scalable, accessible, and performant web platforms. We're currently seeking full-stack developers to join our engineering team, with a strong emphasis on deep WordPress and modern JavaScript experience .


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to join our global engineering team. This position focuses on backend development — building and optimizing custom WordPress plugins, APIs, and integrations for large-scale, high-performance websites.

The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of WordPress internals, experience working with enterprise clients, and a strong understanding of scalable, maintainable code.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop custom WordPress plugins and themes from scratch using PHP, MySQL, and modern best practices.
  • Implement advanced custom fields (ACF) , custom post types , and taxonomies for structured data management.
  • Optimize database queries and improve performance across complex WordPress sites (meta queries, caching, indexing).
  • Integrate WordPress with third-party APIs and automation tools (REST, webhook systems, Make/Zapier, Algolia, etc.).
  • Develop and maintain cron jobs , background tasks, and data synchronization scripts.
  • Build and maintain Gutenberg blocks or React-based admin components when required.
  • Ensure sites meet performance, accessibility, and SEO standards (Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (frontend, DevOps, QA, design) following Agile practices.
  • Write clean, well-documented, and unit-tested code following OOP principles and WordPress coding standards.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience , focusing on backend and custom plugin work.
  • Strong proficiency in PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript .
  • Experience with WordPress hooks (actions & filters) , custom queries, and optimization strategies.
  • Proficient in ACF , CPT UI , Gutenberg , and WooCommerce .
  • Solid understanding of WordPress REST API , webhooks , and API integrations .
  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines .
  • Experience with performance optimization , caching mechanisms, and scalable WordPress architectures.
  • Advanced written and spoken English (international client communication required).


Benefits

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support

title: Full Stack AI Software Engineers
description:
We are hiring three Full-Stack AI Software Engineers (remote, US-based client) with 4+ years of experience in software and AI agent development.

The team is small, fast-moving, and highly hands-on. Engineers will design, build, deploy, monitor, and support an AI-driven platform. You will work across the stack, from backend services to AI agent tuning to infrastructure automation. Candidates must be comfortable owning features end‑to‑end, working independently, and collaborating with distributed teams.

Our client develops AI agents that automate lead follow-up and customer inquiries, allowing in‑person staff to focus on high‑value interactions. The platform will be white-labeled, so engineers must build scalable, configurable, API‑driven solutions with strong attention to performance, reliability, and edge‑case handling.


Responsibilities:


Senior Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Lead by example—mentor and guide less experienced engineers
  • Provide architectural direction and ensure technical excellence
  • Drive core business initiatives and scalable AI agent development


Mid‑Level Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Work independently and unblock yourself using AI and other resources
  • Seek guidance when needed—propose solution options, not just problems


Core Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deliver AI agents and related platform features
  • Integrate platform services with CRMs and third‑party APIs
  • Use AI tools, frameworks, and LLMs to enhance workflows, automate tasks, and optimize customer interactions
  • Build and maintain /Django backend services and scalable REST APIs
  • Conduct hands‑on coding, code reviews, and contribute to system architecture
  • Implement automated QA checks, assist with manual QA when needed, and build scripts/tools to improve testing coverage and reliability
  • Participate in real‑time monitoring and automated load balancing of AI agent infrastructure
  • Diagnose and resolve defects—identify root causes and implement long‑term fixes
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non‑technical stakeholders


Required Experience (Must-Have)

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Minimum 4+ years of Software Engineering Experience

Job Description:

Salesforce Release Engineer with expertise in managing Salesforce deployments, release automation, CI/CD pipelines, and version control. The ideal candidate will work closely with development, admin, QA, and business teams to ensure smooth, accurate, and secure Salesforce releases across environments.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Plan, manage, and execute Salesforce release cycles (Sprint deployments, Hotfixes, Patch Releases).
  • Automate deployments using Salesforce DevOps tools (Flosum / Copado / Gearset / AutoRABIT).
  • Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines, version control strategy, and branching model (Git).
  • Perform metadata and data deployments using Change Sets, DevOps tools, and Salesforce CLI (SFDX).
  • Ensure code quality and compliance checks using static code analysis tools (PMD, SonarQube etc.).
  • Perform sandbox refresh strategy, data seeding, and environment management.
  • Troubleshoot deployment/release failures and provide root-cause analysis.
  • Document release processes, deployment logs, runbooks, and best practices.

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Administrative Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $800 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,600 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary:


The Administrative Assistant will be responsible for providing administrative and customer service support, helping to coordinate schedules, maintain communication with internal and external teams, and manage tasks in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and proactive, supporting the client in a variety of tasks to ensure smooth daily operations.


Job Tasks:


  • Calendar Management: Organize schedules, book meetings, and keep calendars up to date.
  • Email Management: Review, prioritize, and organize emails professionally.
  • Task Tracking: Monitor tasks and deadlines using project management tools.
  • Documentation: Prepare reports, take meeting notes, and maintain organized digital files.
  • Customer Support: Communicate with clients and teams via email, chat, and phone as needed.
  • Research Assistance: Support with gathering information and summarizing findings when required.
  • General Admin: Assist with ad-hoc administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • WhatsApp
  • Asana
  • Miro
  • Canva
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para mulheres cis e trans
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas

O que nós estamos procurando:

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

  • Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
  • Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
  • Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Full Stack Engineer, Brazil
description:
About Optibus:

Optibus is a unified software platform revolutionizing public transportation planning, scheduling, and operations in over 7,000 cities worldwide. Using AI, ML, and optimization algorithms, it empowers agencies to design more efficient, equitable, and sustainable transit networks, enhancing passenger access, reducing emissions, and improving driver conditions. With offices globally and a team of 350+ employees, Optibus fosters a collaborative culture centered on innovation, determination, and impact. As the first unicorn in public transportation technology, Optibus is driving the modernization of mass transit to make it the preferred choice for cities and passengers alike.


About the position (role & team):

Optibus is looking for a talented Full Stack Engineer to join our Planning R&D team in the mission of making transportation smarter and more efficient. We're seeking a mid-level engineer with a strong software development background and experience building and maintaining modern web applications.

As a Full Stack Engineer on the Planning Team, you’ll contribute to the development of features and improvements for our mass transportation planning products, collaborating with other engineers, product managers, and designers to create high-quality, user-focused solutions.


Responsibilities :

  • Develop, deploy, and maintain full-stack applications using React, TypeScript in the frontend, and Node.js with TypeScript deployed on K8S in the backend
  • Actively participate in the entire development lifecycle, engaging in technical discussions
  • Collaborate with the Product Manager and Designer to deliver robust, scalable features.


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of full-stack web development
  • Experience with React client-side development
  • Experience with Node.js server-side development
  • Understanding of web application architecture
  • Familiarity with relational or NoSQL DBs (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in computer science or a related field
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills


It would be great if you have:

  • Experience with Python
  • Experience with AWS or an alternative cloud environment
  • Experience in the mobility ecosystem
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and CI/CD processes


Optibus is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, cultural background, religious beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. It is our responsibility at Optibus to provide an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all. We will provide reasonable accommodations for all candidates in need of individualised support during the hiring process.

title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas

O que nós estamos procurando:

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

  • Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
  • Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
  • Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Linux System Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Linux System Engineer to join our InComm Operations team. Ideally, you will have a strong background in Red Hat and Oracle Linux system administration, automation with Ansible, as well as deep expertise in Linux patching, scripting, and GIT version control.


100% Remote + CLT + Benefits (Health Insurance Coverage, Meal Vouchers, Annual Bonuses, and more!)


Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and manage Linux system infrastructure, primarily Red Hat and Oracle Linux.
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize Ansible playbooks and roles for configuration management and deployment automation.
  • Perform advanced Linux patching, security updates, and OS hardening.
  • Write and maintain Bash scripts for automation and system maintenance tasks.
  • Administer and support Red Hat Satellite for system provisioning, patching, and lifecycle management.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex Linux system issues in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with DevOps, application, and security teams to ensure consistent environments.
  • Manage source code and configuration using GIT repositories.
  • Monitor system performance, reliability, and security using industry-standard tools.
  • Document processes, system changes, and configurations.


Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in Linux System Administration (Red Hat Enterprise Linux and Oracle Linux).
  • Strong proficiency in Ansible, including custom module development and troubleshooting.
  • Advanced bash scripting skills for automation and system tasks.
  • Proficient in GIT for version control and collaboration.
  • Experience with Red Hat Satellite for system provisioning and patch management.
  • Deep understanding of Linux patching strategies, kernel upgrades, and OS lifecycle management.
  • Experience working in secure, enterprise IT environments.
  • Excellent problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) or equivalent certification.
  • Experience with other scripting languages such as Python or Perl.
  • Familiarity with configuration management, CI/CD pipelines, and monitoring tools.
  • Exposure to cloud environments (AWS, Azure) with Linux workloads.

Work Environment:

  • Requires participation in on-call rotation and after-hours support.
  • Fast-paced, collaborative IT infrastructure team.

title: Viral video content creator
description:
Looking for a Viral Video Scriptwriter + Editor who can consistently create viral-style performance video ads using AI tools at scale. You will own the output like it’s your channel, not a “tasks” role.

We run performance marketing campaigns and need a steady pipeline of fresh, high-converting video creatives for the US consumer.

Mission for this job

Own the end-to-end creative pipeline for short-form video ads:

  • Research the market and audience
  • Write scripts that hook hard and hold attention
  • Edit fast, clean videos using AI + simple editing tools
  • Ship volume, learn from results, and iterate daily
What success looks likeFirst 30 days
  • Learn our offers, compliance guardrails, and what “good” looks like for us.
  • Deliver a consistent daily output of scripts + edited videos (with clear naming and organization).
  • Build a repeatable workflow using AI tools for speed (script, voice, visuals, editing, captions).
  • Show you can research the US consumer and write in natural, native-sounding English.
By 90 days
  • Ship a reliable volume of creatives every week with clear variation by hook, angle, and structure.
  • Consistently produce multiple “winners” per month (videos we can scale spend behind).
  • Maintain a simple testing system: what you tried, what worked, what failed, and what to do next.
  • Become independent: you don’t wait for perfect direction to move.
By 12 months
  • Fully own a creative machine that feeds our ad accounts nonstop.
  • Have a documented system another creator could follow.
  • Be the go-to person for viral ad formats, hooks, and creative strategy across offers.
What you will do
  • Write short-form ad scripts (UGC style, narration, simple scenes, strong hooks).
  • Do research (audience pains, language, objections, comments, competitor ads).
  • Edit videos in CapCut (or similar) and ship finished assets ready to launch.
  • Use AI tools to generate footage, b-roll, voice, captions, and variations fast.
  • Create lots of iterations: new hooks, new openings, new pacing, new visuals.
  • Organize deliverables cleanly (folders, versions, naming, notes).
Who you are
  • You have a portfolio of viral videos, ad creatives, or short-form edits.
  • You have strong English and can write like a real US consumer talks.
  • You understand basic copywriting: hook, problem, proof, offer, CTA.
  • You can edit quickly in CapCut (or similar) and keep pacing tight.
  • You’ve used AI tools to create videos at scale (not just one-offs).
  • You move fast, learn fast, and you care more about output and results than comfort.


Core values

Resourcefulness – You figure things out with minimal help.

Perfectly acceptable over perfection – Ship fast, then improve.

Constructive disagreement – Challenge ideas to get to the truth.

Kind, not nice – Honest feedback that helps people win long term.

Growth mindset – Learn from misses, don’t repeat mistakes.

Full ownership – Act like the outcome is on you.


Offer

Competitive pay + profit share based on skill and output, with clear growth as you produce consistent winners.

Apply

Email

with:

  • Your portfolio (required if you have it)
  • A short note on your AI + editing workflow
  • 2–3 examples you’re most proud of and why they worked

If you don’t have a portfolio but you’re sure you can win in this role, email anyway and explain your background plus how you’ll prove yourself fast.

title: Viral video content creator
description:
Looking for a Viral Video Scriptwriter + Editor who can consistently create viral-style performance video ads using AI tools at scale. You will own the output like it’s your channel, not a “tasks” role.

We run performance marketing campaigns and need a steady pipeline of fresh, high-converting video creatives for the US consumer.

Mission for this job

Own the end-to-end creative pipeline for short-form video ads:

  • Research the market and audience
  • Write scripts that hook hard and hold attention
  • Edit fast, clean videos using AI + simple editing tools
  • Ship volume, learn from results, and iterate daily
What success looks likeFirst 30 days
  • Learn our offers, compliance guardrails, and what “good” looks like for us.
  • Deliver a consistent daily output of scripts + edited videos (with clear naming and organization).
  • Build a repeatable workflow using AI tools for speed (script, voice, visuals, editing, captions).
  • Show you can research the US consumer and write in natural, native-sounding English.
By 90 days
  • Ship a reliable volume of creatives every week with clear variation by hook, angle, and structure.
  • Consistently produce multiple “winners” per month (videos we can scale spend behind).
  • Maintain a simple testing system: what you tried, what worked, what failed, and what to do next.
  • Become independent: you don’t wait for perfect direction to move.
By 12 months
  • Fully own a creative machine that feeds our ad accounts nonstop.
  • Have a documented system another creator could follow.
  • Be the go-to person for viral ad formats, hooks, and creative strategy across offers.
What you will do
  • Write short-form ad scripts (UGC style, narration, simple scenes, strong hooks).
  • Do research (audience pains, language, objections, comments, competitor ads).
  • Edit videos in CapCut (or similar) and ship finished assets ready to launch.
  • Use AI tools to generate footage, b-roll, voice, captions, and variations fast.
  • Create lots of iterations: new hooks, new openings, new pacing, new visuals.
  • Organize deliverables cleanly (folders, versions, naming, notes).
Who you are
  • You have a portfolio of viral videos, ad creatives, or short-form edits.
  • You have strong English and can write like a real US consumer talks.
  • You understand basic copywriting: hook, problem, proof, offer, CTA.
  • You can edit quickly in CapCut (or similar) and keep pacing tight.
  • You’ve used AI tools to create videos at scale (not just one-offs).
  • You move fast, learn fast, and you care more about output and results than comfort.


Core values

Resourcefulness – You figure things out with minimal help.

Perfectly acceptable over perfection – Ship fast, then improve.

Constructive disagreement – Challenge ideas to get to the truth.

Kind, not nice – Honest feedback that helps people win long term.

Growth mindset – Learn from misses, don’t repeat mistakes.

Full ownership – Act like the outcome is on you.


Offer

Competitive pay + profit share based on skill and output, with clear growth as you produce consistent winners.

Apply

Email

with:

  • Your portfolio (required if you have it)
  • A short note on your AI + editing workflow
  • 2–3 examples you’re most proud of and why they worked

If you don’t have a portfolio but you’re sure you can win in this role, email anyway and explain your background plus how you’ll prove yourself fast.

title: Data Engineer
description:
What is Teachable?

Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!



About your Team

At Teachable, our Data Team is all about getting things done with minimal overhead. We work closely together, sharing ideas, designing efficient systems, and building a robust data platform that supports the entire organization. Reporting to the Data Engineering Manager, you’ll take the lead on key initiatives, from optimizing our data platform to shaping the future of our events pipeline and ETL processes.

Our data infrastructure is primarily hosted on AWS. We leverage managed Airflow for orchestration, managed Kafka for event collection, Redshift for analytics, and S3 for data lake storage. Working as a Mid-level Analyst, you will partner with Finance to build metrics and data models that facilitate data exploration and business logic integration, supporting the continuous improvement of the data platform.


The Impact You'll Make

In this role, you'll be at the heart of our data strategy, taking ownership of mission-critical infrastructure that supports teams across the company. You’ll also have the opportunity to make strategic recommendations on how we can evolve our data platform to stay ahead of the curve.


What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Engineering and Product teams on high-impact initiatives.
  • Design and implement robust data pipelines using AWS services.
  • Enhance event collection, queueing, and processing mechanisms.
  • Build and refine meaningful alerts with automated corrective actions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues, ensuring system reliability and stability.
  • Architect scalable data products with long-term vision and efficiency in mind.
  • Identify and resolve complex technical challenges involving system integration, infrastructure, and software bugs.


About You

  • 2-3+ years of experience in Data Engineering
  • Fluency in English is required
  • Strong knowledge of modern data engineering practices and software engineering principles
  • Solid experience with cloud infrastructure, especially AWS data services
  • Advanced understanding of relational data modeling
  • Strong SQL skills and Python for data wrangling
  • Hands-on experience with data lake technologies (Delta Lake, Hudi, or Iceberg)
  • Experience working with large-scale data warehouses (e.g., Redshift)
  • Experience integrating with RESTful APIs and webhooks
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices, Git version control, and clean coding standards
  • Exposure to monitoring and incident management tools (e.g., CloudWatch, New Relic, PagerDuty)
  • Collaborative team player who values diversity and cross-functional collaboration


  • Nice to have:
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform )
  • Experience building and orchestrating data pipelines using Airflow and Spark


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


This position will be located remotely in Brazil working with Teachable’s data team based in the United States and Hotmart’s data team in Brazil.

title: Data Analyst
description:
We're looking for a Data Analytics & Engineering Specialist in Brazil!!

We are looking for a gritty problem solver and self-starter who will serve as a key interface between the Analytics and Engineering teams.   • 2+ years of experience in analytics and data engineering.
  • 1+ year of hands-on experience with big data processing systems such as Hadoop, Hive, Spark, or similar technologies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Degree in a STEM field (Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or related area).
  • Experience with BI and data visualization tools such as MicroStrategy, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with Unix/Linux shell scripting and Python.
  • Strong database performance tuning and optimization skills.


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, mathematics, or related field preferred.

  • Capacidade analítica e funcional: Habilidade para traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas eficazes.
  • Comunicação: Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, relacionamento e gestão de stakeholders.

title: Senior Back-End Engineer (PHP, Node.js, OR Python)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Back-End Engineer with 5+ years of experience. The role focuses on designing and building the secure, scalable API and service integrations that connect SaaS products, data warehouse, and embedded analytics ecosystem.

This role acts as the bridge between the application stack and the data platform, ensuring that analytics, reporting, and automation capabilities are seamlessly exposed to both internal systems and customer-facing applications.

The ideal candidate is a backend engineer experienced with modern frameworks (PHP, Node.js, or Python), API design, multi-tenant authentication (Auth0/SSO), and data service abstractions. They combine strong engineering fundamentals with a deep appreciation for performance, security, and maintainability.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement RESTful and GraphQL APIs that expose warehouse and reporting data to SaaS applications and third-party systems
  • Develop scalable, tenant-aware service layers that abstract complex Redshift or Snowflake queries behind stable, versioned interfaces
  • Build secure integrations between the SaaS application and analytics systems (QuickSight embedding, SSO/role propagation, etc.)
  • Ensure multi-tenant context propagation and data isolation across all API endpoints
  • Work with the Data Platform and Analytics teams to define reusable data-access abstractions
  • Collaborate with the Data Platform Architect to design backend patterns supporting large-scale, automated reporting workloads
  • Implement caching, pagination, and batching strategies for high-volume, concurrent
  • analytics requests
  • Monitor API latency and database query efficiency, applying indexing and optimization
  • where necessary
  • Contribute to system design documentation, endpoint versioning, and architecture diagrams
  • Integrate SSO and identity management (Auth0, Cognito, or OIDC) into all service endpoints
  • Enforce least-privilege data access and row-level security (RLS) through token or role propagation
  • Ensure compliance with PII and data governance policies, encryption standards, and audit logging
  • Collaborate with InfoSec and Compliance teams to perform code reviews and security assessments
  • Work with DevOps to deploy and scale backend services via Docker, ECS, or EKS pipelines
  • Implement CI/CD automation for service deployment, schema migrations, and integration tests
  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code definitions (Terraform or CloudFormation)
  • Support observability and monitoring via CloudWatch, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry
  • Partner with Analytics Engineers and Data Platform teams to ensure APIs align with data contracts and warehouse schemas
  • Collaborate with Product Managers to define API requirements and roadmap priorities
  • Participate in technical design reviews, security audits, and postmortems
  • Continuously improve service performance, reliability, and developer experience


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of backend or integration engineering experience in a modern web stack
  • Proficiency in PHP (Laminas, Symfony, Laravel), Node.js, or Python for backend service development
  • Experience designing and maintaining RESTful and GraphQL APIs at scale
  • Hands-on experience integrating data warehouse APIs (Redshift, Snowflake) or analytics services (QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI)
  • Solid understanding of multi-tenant authentication and authorization (SSO, OAuth2, OpenID Connect)
  • Familiarity with AWS services including Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, and CloudFormation
  • Strong knowledge of SQL and data-access patterns, including query optimization and caching
  • Proven experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and API observability


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some type of technical engineering
  • Experience with embedded analytics frameworks (AWS QuickSight Embedding SDK, Looker Embed, etc.)
  • Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS architectures (tenant isolation, provisioning, and lifecycle automation)
  • Knowledge of GraphQL federation, caching layers (Redis), and event-driven designs
  • Experience in data-driven SaaS products (hospitality, property management, or fintech a plus)
  • Exposure to data governance, lineage, and API auditing practices


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient


We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.


Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Graphic Designer to join our growing team!


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.


Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in.   • Create visually appealing designs for various platforms, including digital, print, social media, and branding.
  • Use AI tools and design software to streamline the design process, generate ideas, and automate repetitive tasks, ensuring fresh and innovative results.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (marketing, content, etc.) to deliver high-quality design solutions that align with brand guidelines and project goals.
  • Work on design projects from start to finish, ensuring designs are on-brand, on-time, and meet all requirements.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest design trends, tools, and AI technologies to keep your work innovative and relevant.
  • Edit and optimize designs for various media, ensuring the best quality and user experience across devices.


Qualifications

  • Strong experience as a graphic designer, with a portfolio showcasing your skills in visual design, creativity, and problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in design software like Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Canva, Figma, or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft programs (PowerPoint and Word)
  • Familiarity with AI-powered design tools (such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Nanobanana, Midjourney, Firefly, Freepik AI, etc.) and an eagerness to explore new AI technologies.
  • Understanding of digital design principles for social media, websites, and other online platforms.
  • Understanding of small-scale and large-scale print materials (such as business cards, flyers, menus, conference collateral, merchandise, banners, backdrops, etc.)
  • Ability to work efficiently, meet deadlines, and manage multiple design projects simultaneously.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with team members.

Our operating hours are 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST, Monday to Friday.

title: Professor de italiano
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.


Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Graphic Designer to join our growing team!


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.


Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription for our clients. And we need your help!


Key Responsibilities

  • Create visually appealing designs for various platforms, including digital, print, social media, and branding.
  • Use AI tools and design software to streamline the design process, generate ideas, and automate repetitive tasks, ensuring fresh and innovative results.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (marketing, content, etc.) to deliver high-quality design solutions that align with brand guidelines and project goals.
  • Work on design projects from start to finish, ensuring designs are on-brand, on-time, and meet all requirements.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest design trends, tools, and AI technologies to keep your work innovative and relevant.
  • Edit and optimize designs for various media, ensuring the best quality and user experience across devices.


Qualifications

  • Strong experience as a graphic designer, with a portfolio showcasing your skills in visual design, creativity, and problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in design software like Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Canva, Figma, or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft programs (PowerPoint and Word)
  • Familiarity with AI-powered design tools (such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Nanobanana, Midjourney, Firefly, Freepik AI, etc.) and an eagerness to explore new AI technologies.
  • Understanding of digital design principles for social media, websites, and other online platforms.
  • Understanding of small-scale and large-scale print materials (such as business cards, flyers, menus, conference collateral, merchandise, banners, backdrops, etc.)
  • Ability to work efficiently, meet deadlines, and manage multiple design projects simultaneously.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with team members.
  • A working level of written and spoken English


Our operating hours are 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST, Monday to Friday.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
About Teachable:

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? As part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


What is the role?

This is a Senior Customer Success Analyst role for someone who operates comfortably without a fixed scope, moves fluidly between strategy and execution, and takes ownership not just of relationships, but of outcomes.


At Teachable, creators are entrepreneurs who build, market, and scale digital education businesses, using our platform as their core operating system. You will own a portfolio of high-potential creators and drive retention, growth, and expansion by acting as a strategic and tactical advisor. This role goes beyond relationship management: you will diagnose business challenges, form a point of view, and deliver clear, actionable recommendations that help creators scale their businesses through product adoption, marketing, and growth strategies.


As our Customer Success model continues to evolve, the scope and engagement approach of your portfolio may change over time. This role is well-suited for someone who is comfortable operating in this context and adjusting priorities thoughtfully as the team scales.


In this role you’ll:

  • Own and manage a portfolio of high-potential creators, where portfolio size, composition, and engagement approach may evolve over time as our Customer Success model continues to take shape.
  • Be accountable for retention and growth outcomes across your portfolio by turning goals into concrete success plans, defining what “good” looks like for each account, and influencing customer decisions through clear recommendations, follow-ups, and next steps.
  • Act as a trusted advisor by diagnosing business problems, forming a point of view, and recommending specific actions related to sales, marketing, monetization, and platform usage. This role requires comfort moving from strategy to tactics (including discussing offers, funnels, launches, pricing, and distribution) and clearly articulating what the customer should do next.
  • Engage directly and hands-on with creators across your portfolio, flexing between high-touch 1:1 support and scalable engagement models as needed. You will help design, run, and iterate on scalable initiatives (e.g. group coaching, campaigns, enablement content) as we continue to evolve our engagement playbooks.
  • Drive product adoption by connecting Teachable’s features and tools to concrete business use cases, helping creators understand what to adopt, when to adopt it, and how it supports their growth.
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, PMM, Sales, Support, Data, and Revenue Operations to surface customer insights, align on priorities, and influence decisions that improve the end-to-end creator experience.
  • Actively contribute to the evolution of our Customer Success function by identifying patterns across your portfolio, testing new approaches, documenting what works (and what doesn’t), and translating individual insights into repeatable motions for the broader team.


Must haves:

  • 4+ years of experience owning a book of business in Customer Success, Account Management, Sales, or Business Development, with direct responsibility for retention, expansion, or revenue outcomes, beyond relationship maintenance
  • Experience managing a portfolio where growth was not guaranteed, requiring you to diagnose why accounts were plateauing and to take ownership of changing those outcomes
  • Proven ability to advise customers running complex businesses, with multiple stakeholders and unclear paths to growth, translating ambiguity into clear priorities and execution plans
  • Demonstrated comfort operating across high-touch and scaled engagement models, including knowing when to go deep 1:1 and when to drive impact through programs, campaigns, or enablement
  • Ability to develop a clear point of view, challenge customer assumptions, and influence decisions
  • Track record of turning incomplete data and weak signals into structured action plans, and following through to drive measurable business results
  • Strong analytical skills, with hands-on experience using customer, revenue, and product data to identify risks, opportunities, and concrete levers for growth
  • Practical experience using CRM and analytics tools to actively manage, prioritize, and evolve a portfolio strategy
  • Fluent in English, with confidence leading both strategic and tactical conversations (all of your portfolio will speak english)


Nice to haves:

  • Experience working with founders, creators, or entrepreneurs who own both strategy and execution of their businesses
  • Background in growth, monetization, or go-to-market strategy, particularly in digital or SaaS businesses
  • Experience designing, running, or iterating on scaled Customer Success motions (programs, group coaching, campaigns, enablement) alongside 1:1 engagement


You’ll be a great fit for this role if you:

  • Enjoy a proactive, growth-oriented Customer Success role , where you go beyond relationship maintenance and actively identify opportunities to drive customer impact
  • Thrive in a dynamic environment , managing evolving portfolios and adapting your engagement approach as customer needs change
  • Prefer working with autonomy and judgment , using your experience to make decisions rather than relying solely on rigid playbooks


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

description:
About Teachable:

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? As part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


What is the role?

This is a Senior Customer Success Analyst role for someone who operates comfortably without a fixed scope, moves fluidly between strategy and execution, and takes ownership not just of relationships, but of outcomes.


At Teachable, creators are entrepreneurs who build, market, and scale digital education businesses, using our platform as their core operating system. You will own a portfolio of high-potential creators and drive retention, growth, and expansion by acting as a strategic and tactical advisor. This role goes beyond relationship management: you will diagnose business challenges, form a point of view, and deliver clear, actionable recommendations that help creators scale their businesses through product adoption, marketing, and growth strategies.


As our Customer Success model continues to evolve, the scope and engagement approach of your portfolio may change over time. This role is well-suited for someone who is comfortable operating in this context and adjusting priorities thoughtfully as the team scales.


In this role you’ll:

  • Own and manage a portfolio of high-potential creators, where portfolio size, composition, and engagement approach may evolve over time as our Customer Success model continues to take shape.
  • Be accountable for retention and growth outcomes across your portfolio by turning goals into concrete success plans, defining what “good” looks like for each account, and influencing customer decisions through clear recommendations, follow-ups, and next steps.
  • Act as a trusted advisor by diagnosing business problems, forming a point of view, and recommending specific actions related to sales, marketing, monetization, and platform usage. This role requires comfort moving from strategy to tactics (including discussing offers, funnels, launches, pricing, and distribution) and clearly articulating what the customer should do next.
  • Engage directly and hands-on with creators across your portfolio, flexing between high-touch 1:1 support and scalable engagement models as needed. You will help design, run, and iterate on scalable initiatives (e.g. group coaching, campaigns, enablement content) as we continue to evolve our engagement playbooks.
  • Drive product adoption by connecting Teachable’s features and tools to concrete business use cases, helping creators understand what to adopt, when to adopt it, and how it supports their growth.
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, PMM, Sales, Support, Data, and Revenue Operations to surface customer insights, align on priorities, and influence decisions that improve the end-to-end creator experience.
  • Actively contribute to the evolution of our Customer Success function by identifying patterns across your portfolio, testing new approaches, documenting what works (and what doesn’t), and translating individual insights into repeatable motions for the broader team.


Must haves:

  • 4+ years of experience owning a book of business in Customer Success, Account Management, Sales, or Business Development, with direct responsibility for retention, expansion, or revenue outcomes, beyond relationship maintenance
  • Experience managing a portfolio where growth was not guaranteed, requiring you to diagnose why accounts were plateauing and to take ownership of changing those outcomes
  • Proven ability to advise customers running complex businesses, with multiple stakeholders and unclear paths to growth, translating ambiguity into clear priorities and execution plans
  • Demonstrated comfort operating across high-touch and scaled engagement models, including knowing when to go deep 1:1 and when to drive impact through programs, campaigns, or enablement
  • Ability to develop a clear point of view, challenge customer assumptions, and influence decisions
  • Track record of turning incomplete data and weak signals into structured action plans, and following through to drive measurable business results
  • Strong analytical skills, with hands-on experience using customer, revenue, and product data to identify risks, opportunities, and concrete levers for growth
  • Practical experience using CRM and analytics tools to actively manage, prioritize, and evolve a portfolio strategy
  • Fluent in English, with confidence leading both strategic and tactical conversations (all of your portfolio will speak english)


Nice to haves:

  • Experience working with founders, creators, or entrepreneurs who own both strategy and execution of their businesses
  • Background in growth, monetization, or go-to-market strategy, particularly in digital or SaaS businesses
  • Experience designing, running, or iterating on scaled Customer Success motions (programs, group coaching, campaigns, enablement) alongside 1:1 engagement


You’ll be a great fit for this role if you:

  • Enjoy a proactive, growth-oriented Customer Success role , where you go beyond relationship maintenance and actively identify opportunities to drive customer impact
  • Thrive in a dynamic environment , managing evolving portfolios and adapting your engagement approach as customer needs change
  • Prefer working with autonomy and judgment , using your experience to make decisions rather than relying solely on rigid playbooks


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges, collaborate on an interesting product, be up to date with the latest technology, and contribute to taking our product to market? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s.


We are currently hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer with AWS CDK knowledge for an initial 12-month B2B Contract on a remote basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (EDA architecture) and TypeScript and willing to pick up new technologies as needed.


Responsibilities:

  • Participate in our DevOps team
  • Ensure the quality of our AWS infrastructure
  • Develop and review infrastructure code that enhances performance and cost efficiency
  • Ensure seamless integration of all AWS services within our architecture
  • Optimize the infrastructure for continuous scalability
  • Drive ongoing improvements in CI/CD pipelines
  • Collaborate with development teams, the CTO, and technical leads


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 6 years relevant experience working in DevOps roles
  • Hands-on experience with TypeScript and AWS CDK
  • Coding experience in implementing business features
  • Familiarity with AWS services, including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront, EventBridge, AppSync, DynamoDb, OpenSearch
  • Business-level proficiency in English


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working remotely and independently, with some overlap with HQ work schedule
  • Take ownership and be accountable for their work
  • Be eager to work on various aspects of our cloud infrastructure in a generalist role
  • Quickly familiarize themselves with our infrastructure to generate new ideas and improve our existing setup
  • Have experience supporting other teams in implementing AWS solutions
  • Adopt a proactive, hands-on approach


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together?A flat hierarchical structure with room for innovation in a highly motivated team.
  • A start-up environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we have show-and-tell energy, and we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We love building beautiful software and get hyped by always raising the bar on quality. Our product is beautiful inside and outside. How do we achieve this? By always asking ourselves “Is this right?” or “Does this make sense?”.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

description:

Há mais de 40 anos no mercado ajudando as empresas a desenvolverem e evoluírem a sua vantagem competitiva por meio de uma abordagem orientada a negócios, colocando a Inteligência Artificial no centro de sua operação, explorando ecossistemas e plataformas digitais e adotando o mindset API First para reconfigurar e inovar a cadeia de valor, gerando novos modelos de negócios e uma melhor experiência do cliente.

Com mais de 1000 colaboradores no Brasil, a Engineering é uma das maiores e mais inovadoras empresas presente no País e considerada um dos melhores lugares para se trabalhar.

Atuar como elo estratégico entre as áreas de negócio e tecnologia, com foco em Technology Business Management (TBM).
